note: Food found. Frequent and small, so it teaches steadily without dominating the ledger.
Followed something to where it was. Rewarded because the following is the skill, not the finding.
Won. Capped hard: a clan that learns fighting always pays is a clan that stops eating.
Killed something.
Lost. Weighted heavier than a win, because the asymmetry is real.
Per point. Small and uncapped-feeling by design — it is the background pressure, not an event.
Survived, but the culture should remember this as a failure of everything leading up to it.
Something broke.
Taking the hit for someone. The behaviour the Guardian arc is built out of.
Per point absorbed on someone else's behalf.
The worst thing in the catalog that is not a death.
Care given.
Panic stopped.
The largest positive in the catalog. Everything else is instrumental to this.
Bred.
Per day. The clan should feel this as a standing indictment of its foraging policy.
The world bit.
Alone. Small per day and ruinous over a season, which is how isolation actually works.
Went to look at the strange thing and came back. Curiosity has to pay or it is bred out.
Saw it coming. Rewards vigilance, which otherwise looks identical to doing nothing.
Somewhere new.
Per unit, deliberately near-zero. Present so migration is not invisible; too small to farm.
